Description

Keep warm or cool meals as yummy as you packed them with Bentgo® Kids Stainless Steel Food Jar available in our bestselling Bentgo Kids Prints! Aside from its fun look, the leak-proof design allows your kiddos to take meals to school, the park, and beyond worry-free. From chicken noodle soup to fruit yogurt parfaits and mac and cheese, you can finally pack saucy meals without the mess – and feel good knowing they’ll be enjoyed at the perfect temperature. Made with double-wall vacuum insulation that keeps food warm or cool for hours, your littles can eat their meals out of this 11oz wide-mouth container at the same temp that you prepared them by lunchtime. Bentgo Kids Stainless Steel Food Jar is completely kid-friendly – featuring an easy-open plastic lid that fits little hands and a removable, non-slip silicone bumper that gives extra protection against accidental drops. Made with BPA-free materials and top-rack dishwasher safe for easy clean up, this is the perfect mess-free food container for warm or cool meals on the go! 

Features
  • LEAK-PROOF DESIGN: Pack yummy meals in this leak-proof food container without having to worry about spills! From warm chicken soup for school to cold fruit and yogurt for daycare, you can pack up to 11oz of your child’s favorite food mess-free.
  • KID-FRIENDLY FEATURES: Easy open plastic lid can be gripped by little hands, making it simple to open and secure when it’s time to eat. For the most active littles, the bottom silicone bumper gives extra protection against accidental drops.
  • DOUBLE INSULATION: Keep meals and snacks warm or cool for hours with double-wall vacuum insulation and durable 18/8 stainless steel. The entire look is finished off with a colorful, semi-matte finish of our fun and bestselling Bentgo Kids Print!
  • EASY TO CLEAN: Made with BPA-free materials, the food jar is top-rack dishwasher safe for easy clean up. Hand washing is recommended to preserve the leak-proof seal. The silicone bumper is also removable for easy cleaning and no hidden stains.
  • PURCHASE WITH A PURPOSE: Bentgo continues to be a proud supporter of Feed the Children, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that gives hope and resources for hungry children and families. Since 2017, Bentgo has donated nearly $300,000 to help end hunger.
Product Specifications
  • Size: 3.6 in (9.1 cm) x 4.8 in (12.2 cm)
  • Total Capacity: 1.4 cups | 11 oz | 325.3 mL
  • Weight: 0.84 lb
  • Material: Food grade materials (18/8 stainless steel, PP, and silicone)
